# compute_surface_area_mc_lattice { #mofography.compute.compute_surface_area_mc_lattice }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> MC shell area with lattice accessibility; comparison to winding MC variant. Use `compute_surface_area_mc_winding` instead.

```python
compute.compute_surface_area_mc_lattice(
    results_dict,
    mat_atoms,
    probe_radius=None,
    n_samples=20000,
    shell_thickness=0.5,
    return_details=False,
    variant='v2',
)
```

Monte Carlo shell surface area with lattice accessibility.
